text.heading: Three hundred rupees a day
text.sub: A coffee. A cab. A delivery order.

text.heading: Nobody notices it leaving
text.label: one year of the habit
text.foot: and that is just year one

text.heading: That money was never resting
text.note: It was waiting to be put to work.

text.channel: Subscribe for one money idea a day
text.assumption: Assumes {habit_rate} a year over {habit_years} years. Returns are not guaranteed.

voice.s1: Three hundred rupees a day. One coffee on the way to work, one cab you could have skipped, one dinner you did not feel like cooking. Nobody budgets for it, because nobody thinks it is worth budgeting for.
voice.s2: Watch what it actually looks like. Three hundred rupees, every single day, quietly leaving your wallet. By the end of one year that is {year_one_invested}, and you will struggle to name a single thing you bought with it.
voice.s3: Now keep that habit for twenty years, the way most of us do without ever deciding to. Stack every one of those notes on top of each other and the pile comes to {habit_invested}. That is not a typo. That is a small apartment, paid for in coffee.
voice.s4: Here is the part that stings. That money was never resting. It was waiting. Every rupee you spend today is a rupee that could have been earning for the next twenty years.
voice.s5: So let us run it the other way. Same three hundred rupees a day, same twenty years, but this time it goes into an index fund instead of a cup. At {habit_rate} a year, that habit turns into {habit_final_long}. You did not earn more. You did not work harder. You just stopped letting it leak.
voice.s6: Put the two side by side, because this is the whole video in one picture. Same person, same salary, same twenty years. One of them spent {habit_invested}. The other one is holding {habit_final}.
voice.s7: You do not have to give anything up to start. Name the habit, so you can actually see it. Halve it, not quit it, because the ones you quit come back. Then automate the rest on the same day your salary lands.
voice.s8: Pick one habit this week and point it somewhere better. That is the whole job. I am Money in Sixty, and I will see you in the next one.
